lines.vo: Ever had one bad day turn into a whole bad week?
That's not a lack of willpower. It has a name.
Tasha blew Monday, so she almost closes her Life Reset Planner for good.
Researchers call it the what the hell effect.
In a classic study, dieters who believed they'd already broken their diet went on to eat more, not less.
One slip made the whole day feel ruined, so they stopped trying.
But one bad day is just one box. The rest of the week is still blank.
Skip the guilt and fill in the next box. That's how you get back on track.
